terra.problem: The text says the seed was trampled, but does not say people walked over it or establish that the birds ate it afterward.
The claim that the seed never had a chance to sprout adds a detail about timing that the text does not give.
The text says the seed was trampled but does not identify foot traffic as the cause.
The passage says the seedlings lacked moisture, not that nothing underneath was feeding them.
The explanation is flat and generic throughout, despite a natural opening for Papa Dorin's excitement or humor.
The text says the disciples asked what the parable meant; it does not say whether they had pretended to understand.
The passage does not say the disciples leave after Jesus explains the parable.
The last two sentences are generic and repetitive rather than adding a meaningful explanation or Papa Dorin's personality.
Jesus says the people are choked and their fruit does not mature. He does not say the word is crowded out.
Hearing once and moving on is not what Jesus says happens with the other soils.
Jesus says whoever has will be given more, not that what he has will be doubled.
